content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: The post of Professor carries a consolidated remuneration of Rs. 3,05,000/- per month. The post of Associate Professor carries a consolidated remuneration of Rs. 2,55,000/- per month. The post of Assistant Professor carries a consolidated remuneration of Rs. 1,95,000/- per month. The emoluments for the post of Specialist Grade - III will be as per revised pay rules Level 11 (Pay Rs. 67,700/- plus admissible allowances per month) and as per rules approved by the Governing Council of JSSH. Specialist Grade - I posts carry a Pay Scale of Rs. 15600-39100 + Grade Pay 6600/- plus allowances as per Contractual engagement terms and conditions of Delhi Government. The appointment of teaching faculty shall be on contract basis for an initial period of 03 years, extendable further for another 02 years, with extension based on annual performance appraisal report up to the age of superannuation in the Government of Delhi. The appointment of Specialist Gr. III and Specialist Grade - I shall be initially on contract for a period of five years with a notice period of three month from either side for severance of contract.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for JSSH Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Download the prescribed application form from the official website (www.jssh.org). Fill in all required details, affix a passport-size photograph, and enclose self-attested copies of certificates. Pay the application fee of Rs. 1000/- for Unreserved and Rs. 500/- for OBC/SC/ST candidates through the POS machine (Credit/Debit Card only) available at Accounts Branch, 1st Floor, JSSH. Enclose the "online transaction receipt" of the application fee and required certificates. Send the completed application through "Speed Post" on or before 06-11-2026 till 4:00 P.M. to the office of "The Director, Administrative Block, 1st Floor, Janakpuri Super Speciality Hospital, C-2B, Jankapuri, New Delhi - 110058". Indicate the name and discipline of the post applied for legibly on the envelope and first page of the prescribed application form.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Certificate in support of age (Class 10th) Certificates and Mark Sheets of Educational Qualifications (Mark sheet of MBBS I, II and Final years, Degree of MBBS, Degree of MD/MS/DNB, Degree of DM/M.Ch/DNB (Super Speciality)/DrNB, and any other qualification) Registration with Delhi Medical Council OBC (Delhi)/SC/ST certificate (if applicable) Experience Certificate(s) No Objection Certificate (if the candidate is already working) Documentary Proof of information furnished from S.No. 12 to 18 Copies of best five publications Application form & other documents as single file in soft copy i.e. CD/DVD

faq.question: Q1. How many total vacancies are available in JSSH Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 27 vacancies have been notified for Faculty and Specialist Gr. III posts.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to submit the application form for JSSH Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for receipt of the application form is 6 November 2026 up to 4:00 P.M.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application fee for JSSH Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The non-refundable application fee is Rs. 1000/- for Unreserved category candidates and Rs. 500/- for OBC/SC/ST candidates, payable through a POS machine at the JSSH Accounts Branch.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for Professor posts in JSSH Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The post of Professor carries a consolidated remuneration of Rs. 3,05,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q5. What is the mode of application for JSSH Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted offline through Speed Post to the Director, Administrative Block, 1st Floor, Janakpuri Super Speciality Hospital, C-2B, Jankapuri, New Delhi - 110058.

faq.question: Q6. Are the posts in JSSH Recruitment 2026 permanent or on contract?
faq.answer: The appointments are made on a contract basis for an initial period of 3 years (for teaching faculty, extendable up to 2 years) or 5 years (for Specialists), subject to performance appraisals.

faq.question: Q7. Is registration with the Delhi Medical Council mandatory?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates must have a valid DMC registration certificate.
